# Tiny Lobby

> Indie studio making short story games you play free in the browser (phone or desktop). Two games: La Abuela (Spanish comedy: you're the grandma and a scammer is calling) and Night Desk (noir interactive fiction: you're a hotel night clerk). Text in Spanish, English and Ukrainian.

## Games

- [La Abuela](https://tinylobby.itch.io/la-abuela): free browser game, about 3 minutes per call. You're the grandma; "your grandson", a lawyer and an inspector call to scam you. Your job is not to hang up: pick your answers and catch the scammer in his own lie. Voiced calls, several endings. Spanish first; also English and Ukrainian. Mirror: https://tinylobbygames.github.io/noche/abuela/
- [Night Desk](https://tinylobby.itch.io/night-desk): free noir interactive fiction, 16+. You are the night clerk of a small hotel; a woman in grey leaves an envelope and $200 for a favour. Six nights, 48 endings, 15–25 minutes a night. Voiced in English and Spanish; text in English, Spanish and Ukrainian. Mirror: https://tinylobbygames.github.io/noche/

## Notes

- Both games are free and need no account.
- Art, voices and music are made with AI tools; the stories are written by the studio with AI help.
